checks.statement: Determinate and indeterminate behavior, fixed 4dp track thickness, and flat shape are available in M3 and M3 Expressive; configurable thickness and wavy shape are M3 Expressive additions.

evidence.result: The mapper separates linear/circular variants and supports token-driven thickness, shape and wave amplitude/wavelength; the runtime reads shape=wave and measures those values.

implementation.notes: The implementation exposes both geometry modes and the expressive wave/thickness configuration through generated tokens and runtime geometry.

implementation.notes: Both documented progress forms have separate supported selectors in the renderer.

evidence.result: Stop size, shape and trailing spacing are mapped from progress tokens; runtime displays the stop only for incomplete linear determinate progress.

implementation.notes: The linear stop geometry is token-driven and the runtime excludes indeterminate/circular states; the 4dp value and contrast requirement depend on captured token data.

checks.statement: For wavy indicators, height is the overall container height, amplitude runs from the center of the resting position to the center of a peak, and wavelength is the distance between adjacent peaks. Thicker variants are sample measurements to adjust for the use case, not fixed defaults.
checks.condition: When using a wavy indicator or selecting a thicker variant.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated explicit measurement definitions and the source caveat on thicker variants.

evidence.result: Wave amplitude and wavelength are mapped from the `with-wave` token set; runtime uses amplitude to derive the path radius/height and wavelength to set wave count along the path.

implementation.notes: The path generator uses container dimensions, active thickness, amplitude and wavelength in the geometry described by the source; thicker sample sizes remain token inputs.
